paper: Forgery-aware Adaptive Transformer for Generalizable Synthetic Image Detection (FatFormer). Liu, Tan, Tan, Wei, Wang, Zhao — CVPR 2024.
training_set_in_paper: ProGAN from CNNDetection/Wang et al., two settings: 2-class (chair,horse) and 4-class (car,cat,chair,horse). Released checkpoint + headline numbers use the 4-class setting. Backbone = CLIP:ViT-L/14 with a forgery-aware adapter + language-guided alignment. README L57-59,27. Eval cmd uses --num_vit_adapter 3 --num_context_embedding 8 (README L122-134).

benchmarks.name: GANs dataset — 8 GANs (4-class ProGAN supervision) — HEADLINE

paper_number.note: README GANs table 'Ours' row Mean = 98.4 acc / 99.7 AP (README L40). Generator set follows LGrad's 8 GANs (README L64-66).

paper_per_generator.note: From README L40. (The CVPR PDF lists StyleGAN2 AP 99.9; README shows 100.0 — within rounding.)

benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: main.py + utils/dataset.py Dataset_Creator (test split, L25-29): transforms.Resize((256,256)) -> CenterCrop(224) -> ToTensor -> Normalize(ImageNet mean/std). Run via torch.distributed 4-GPU, --test_selected_subsets 'progan' .. 'deepfake', --eval, --pretrained_model <ckpt>, --num_vit_adapter 3 --num_context_embedding 8 (README L122-134). Per-subset accuracy_score@0.5 on softmax fake-prob + average_precision_score, mean over subsets.

our_number.ckpt: fat_former.pth (= fatformer_official.pth, OFFICIAL 4-class CLIP:ViT-L/14 weights remapped into the SynthScope class; ckpt_kind=official_fatformer)
our_number.note: SynthScope class + official weights = 99.70 mAP / 98.39 acc — EXACT match to paper 99.7/98.4. Loading verified clean (num_vit_adapter=3).

benchmarks.gap_cause: n/a — exact match. The SynthScope 'number IS the official number': synthscope.load('fat_former') key-remaps the official 492M-param checkpoint and runs it through SynthScope's inference path.
benchmarks.dataset_source: on-disk /hddstore/ssalehi/SynthScope/CNNDetection/test (all 8 subsets present). Official ckpt on-disk /hddstore/ssalehi/SynthScope/repro/ckpts/fatformer_official.pth (~1.97GB), gdrive 1Q_Kgq4ygDf8XEHgAf-SgDN6Ru_IOTLkj.

benchmarks.name: GANs dataset — 8 GANs (2-class ProGAN supervision)

paper_number.note: 2-class mean from the prior PDF-derived spec (paper Table 1 second supervision setting): 95.8 acc / 99.2 AP. NOT in the README table; recorded from the PDF-spec, not re-verified this pass.

benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: Same eval transform/metric as the 4-class row; requires RE-TRAINING FatFormer on 2-class ProGAN (chair,horse) — the released checkpoint is 4-class only.

benchmarks.dataset_source: on-disk for data (CNNDetection train chair/horse classes present); 2-class checkpoint not released.

benchmarks.name: Diffusion-model (DMs) dataset — 10 subsets (4-class ProGAN supervision)

paper_number.note: README DMs table 'Ours' Mean = 95.0 acc / 98.8 AP (README L55), over 10 diffusion subsets. PNDM+VQ-Diffusion come from DIRE; the other 8 from UniversalFakeDetect (README L68-70).

benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: Same Resize((256,256))+CenterCrop(224)+ImageNet-norm; --test_selected_subsets set to the DM names (README L136-137); per-subset acc@0.5 + AP, mean over subsets.

our_number.note: SynthScope evaluated the 8 UniversalFakeDetect DM subsets (dalle, glide x3, guided, ldm x3) = 98.60 mAP / 93.72 acc. The paper's 10-subset table additionally includes PNDM + VQ-Diffusion (both 99.8-100 AP in the paper), which SynthScope's UFD-8 run omits, so our 8-subset mean is not directly comparable to the paper's 10-subset 98.8.

benchmarks.gap_cause: PARTIAL coverage, not a model gap. (1) The SynthScope fatformer_official_ufd run covers only the 8 UniversalFakeDetect DM subsets, not the paper's full 10 (missing PNDM + VQ-Diffusion, which are sourced from DIRE/DiffusionForensics, not UFD). Including them (both near-100 AP in the paper) would raise the mean toward 98.8. (2) SynthScope's guided/ADM AP is the weak cell (91.92, vs paper Guided AP 92.0 — actually matches), so the underlying detector is faithful; the only true gap is the missing 2 subsets in our eval set. Note: SynthScope also has fatformer_official_diffusionforensics (94.66 mAP) but that is the DiffusionForensics adm/ddpm/.. benchmark, which FatFormer does NOT report — out of scope.
benchmarks.dataset_source: PARTIAL on-disk: 8 UFD subsets at /hddstore/ssalehi/SynthScope/universialfakedetection/test. MISSING for faithful 10-subset: PNDM + VQ-Diffusion from DIRE/DiffusionForensics (github.com/ZhendongWang6/DIRE) or the FatFormer authors' DM mirror (Baidu 1zoubPr5n_mGI27En9uyL8Q pwd=a6sw / OneDrive).

summary: FatFormer reports its headline numbers in 2 main tables (GANs 8-subset, DMs 10-subset) plus ablation Tables 3/4 (no new data). We reproduce the HEADLINE GANs table EXACTLY: SynthScope class + official 4-class weights = 99.70 mAP / 98.39 acc = paper 99.7/98.4. The DMs table is BELOW only because our eval covers 8/10 subsets (UniversalFakeDetect set, 98.60 mAP) and omits PNDM+VQ-Diffusion (from DIRE) — a dataset-coverage gap, not a model gap; the per-subset numbers match the paper. The 2-class GANs row is MISSING (only the 4-class checkpoint is released; needs a 2-class retrain). FatFormer is reproduced via official weights remapped into the SynthScope class (ckpt_kind=official_fatformer); the SynthScope number IS the official number. Data caveat: load with num_vit_adapter=3 (README eval cmd), not the SynthScope config default of 8.
